title: The Universe Keeps Its Options Open
evidence_boundary: The double-slit and which-path results are well established. 'Observer' in physics means any interaction that records which-path information - a detector, a photon, an environment - not a conscious mind. This script explicitly rejects the claim that thoughts command matter, and presents interpretations of what the wavefunction represents as open questions rather than settled fact.
desired_movement: From assuming certainty is the foundation of reality to considering that definiteness may be produced when possibility meets an interaction.
grounding: The closing beats return to ordinary facts and the viewer's own past rather than a directive.
invitation: Beneath every fact, nature may have carried more futures than the single one that finally became our past.
end_card_question: What if certainty is the product, not the foundation?
voice_standard: Liam - warm, curious, precise. Genuinely delighted by the apparatus and the interference beats, firm and clear through the no-your-thoughts-do-not-move-matter correction, spacious and quiet through the final turn. Near-whisper on the closing line.

scenes.text: But after many arrivals, those lonely marks assemble into the striped signature of waves interfering with themselves.

scenes.text: Somehow, each particle behaves as though both openings mattered, even though it was detected in only one place.

scenes.text: Then we add a detector and ask the experiment a sharper question: Which path did you take?

scenes.query: A delicate sensor arm moving into a beam chamber as indicator lights activate.

scenes.query: A fan of transparent photographic plates closing until only one image remains.

scenes.text: This does not mean your thoughts command matter, or that wanting something makes the universe obey.

scenes.query: A person concentrating beside an unmoving compass while laboratory machinery operates independently behind them.
